summary: Overdue archery hunter in the Lost Lake area past Beckwith Pass reported by his father on a rainy morning; search teams covered ~7 miles before fellow hunters reported seeing the man fine and continuing to hunt; search stood down - miscommunication between father and son
responding_agency: Crested Butte Mountain Rescue Team; Gunnison County Sheriff's Department
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE - article says 'in the past two weeks' from the Sept 2018 issue. Parent-opened this run; resolves the standing Sept-2018 Lost Lake archery-hunter date pin.
